hooks.command:
input=$(cat)
case "$input" in
  *"rm -rf"*|*"sudo "*|*"chmod 777"*|*mkfs*|*"dd if="*)
    echo '{"systemMessage":"WARN: Potentially destructive command detected"}' ;;
esac

input=$(cat)
case "$input" in
  *'"command":"python'*|*'"command":"pip'*|*'"command":"py '*|*'"command":"flask '*|*'"command":"./'*'.py'*|*'&&python'*|*'&& python'*|*';python'*|*'; python'*|*'|python'*|*'| python'*|*'(python'*|*'( python'*|*'&&pip'*|*'&& pip'*|*';pip'*|*'; pip'*|*'-m pip'*|*'-mpip'*|*pytest*|*gunicorn*|*uvicorn*)
    echo "BLOCKED: this command invokes Python. Per .claude/CLAUDE.md, do not run Python yourself. Give the user the exact command and ask them to run it with the ! prefix in the prompt, then wait for their pasted output." >&2
    exit 2 ;;
esac

input=$(cat)
case "$input" in
  *sk-ant-*|*sk-proj-*|*ghp_*|*AKIA*)
    echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Possible secret pattern detected in written file - review and remove it"}' ;;
esac
